question: The component of white light that has maximum refractive index is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**violet**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Violet** light has the maximum refractive index among the components of white light.
 
• The refractive index of a medium depends on the wavelength of the light passing through it.
 
• Shorter wavelengths of light, such as violet, are refracted more than longer wavelengths like red when passing through a medium.
 
• This phenomenon is why violet light bends more and has a higher refractive index compared to other colors in the visible spectrum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **refractive index** is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced inside a medium compared to its speed in a vacuum.
 
• The refractive index is given by the formula **n = c/v**, where **c** is the speed of light in a vacuum and **v** is the speed of light in the medium.
 
• Light of different wavelengths travels at different speeds in a medium, leading to dispersion and the separation of white light into its constituent colors.
 
• This principle is utilized in prisms and lenses to create various optical effects.
